user.title: Find your library
user.description: Search for your Bibkat library. Polling only reads loans; renewals require an explicit action.

data_description.catalog_id: Choose the library that issued your reader account.

account.title: Connect your reader account
account.description: Credentials are stored in Home Assistant's local configuration. Protect your configuration and backups. Setup does not renew loans.

data_description.name: A label to distinguish family accounts; avoid putting the reader number here.
data_description.username: Your library reader number, including any leading zeros.
data_description.password: The password used to sign in to Bibkat.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your reader account
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current password for this account. Library, reader number and device identity stay unchanged.

data_description.password: The current password used to sign in to Bibkat.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Bibkat. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: Bibkat rejected the login or account access. Check your credentials and library access.
error.invalid_response: Bibkat returned an unexpected or unsuccessful response. No empty loan list was assumed.
error.rate_limited: Bibkat has limited requests. Wait before trying again.
error.no_catalogs: No libraries found. Try a more specific name or a different town.
error.invalid_catalog: Select a library from the search results.

abort.already_configured: This reader account is already configured for this library.

renew.name: Renew medium
renew.description: Request one renewal and verify its new due date. Administrator access required. This changes the library account and never retries the renewal. Not yet live-verified.

config_entry_id.name: Reader account
config_entry_id.description: The Bibkat account that holds this loan.

medium_id.name: Medium ID
medium_id.description: Copy medium_id from the loans attribute, not the ISBN.

expected_due_date.name: Current due date
expected_due_date.description: Copy due_date from the loan. A changed date prevents a duplicate renewal.

account_not_loaded.message: Select a loaded Bibkat reader account.

invalid_renewal_input.message: A valid medium ID and current due date are required.

loan_not_found.message: This medium is not uniquely identified in the account's current loans. No renewal was sent.

due_date_changed.message: The due date has changed. Check the refreshed loan list. No renewal was sent.

not_renewable.message: The library does not currently allow this loan to be renewed, or a request is pending. No renewal was sent.

renewal_unconfirmed.message: The renewal could not be confirmed. It may already have been applied. Check the loan in Bibkat before any new attempt; the request was not repeated.

invalid_auth.message: Bibkat authorization failed. Reauthenticate the reader account.

rate_limited.message: Bibkat has limited requests. Updates have been delayed.

cannot_update.message: Cannot update Bibkat loans. Data is unavailable until a successful update.
